name: tkd-manager
//overrides: tar and @mapbox/node-pre-gyp arrive through `canvas`, an OPTIONAL dependency
of pdfjs-dist that this app never uses — next.config.mjs already aliases
canvas to false, because pdf.js only reaches for it when it thinks it is
running on a server and the template designer is browser-only.
So these carried a critical node-tar advisory into every install for code
that is never loaded. `npm audit fix` could not shift them: the fix is
inside an optional transitive dependency, so it needs saying explicitly.
Forced to current rather than removed, because removing an optional
dependency is a flag on every install anybody ever runs, and one person
forgetting it puts the old tar back.
